label.fr: Confrontation de 50 secondes (un lieu, temps réel)

notes: Plan 22 stage 3 (the human's reference: a 52 s confrontation in one place, about 15 shots of 2-5 s, every line spoken on camera). One continuous scene in real time: the hook, two or three body beats of 10-16 s and the cliffhanger, all in one place (single_place: E1 is told so and max_places is 1), cut together with no time jump (scene_transition: every boundary a cut). The antagonist drives it with demands and accusations, each with its reason; the target answers little; it ends right before the threatened act. Lines of 5-17 words (line_words: on a native-speech story one line is one shot of at most 8 s, 17 words at 2.4 words/s; plan 27: shots are 5-10 s, min_shot_s 5, max_shot_s 10, a reaction shot 6 s), 95-125 spoken words in all (episode_words, spread over the scenes by their length), at most one silent reaction shot a scene (reaction_shots). The narrator speaks only in the recap (narrator_slots; amends DEC-231 for this format only). shots_per_scene [1, 2] is the beat-shot pair of a story that does not speak natively (a body beat past max_shot_s is two shots); a native-speech board plans one shot a line instead. The format a native-speech story starts on (defaults.episode_template_for; DEC-268: still a per-story choice).
